method: Matched empty-box reference and analytic Mie cross section. Fixed physical domain, PML thickness and duration across meshes. All requested cases retained. Single-run timings include preparation, without performance claims.

warnings: TFSF boxes use normal-incidence live Yee lines and a homogeneous background shell. Inside is total field, outside is scattered field. Amplitude scales the auxiliary soft drive. Check incident PML, mesh and time convergence before quantitative scattering.
summary.epsilon_definition: instantaneous relative permittivity (epsilon-infinity for dispersive cells)
summary.units: geometry: um; time: s; E/H: reduced fields; Bloch phase: rad
